---
title: "Molecular tumour board outcomes"
date: 2026-08-24
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

The primary denominator is patients who accepted the invitation. Registration
uses `mtb_reg == 1`, discussion uses `n_mtb >= 1`, and a recommendation report
is counted when `mtb_n_reports >= 1`. The eight-week follow-up group includes
patients whose death or last-known-alive date is at least 56 days after
`enrolled_date` (the consent/enrolment date in the export).

```{r}
#| label: mtb

cohort_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)

result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "results")
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "mtb-summary.parquet")
distribution_path <- file.path(result_dir, "mtb-discussion-distribution.parquet")

dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(cohort_path) |>
  as.data.frame()

accepted <- cohort |>
  dplyr::filter(invitation_accepted == 1L)

if (nrow(accepted) == 0L) stop("No patients accepted the invitation.")

endpoint_date <- as.Date(ifelse(
  accepted$status_death_unrestricted == 1L,
  as.character(accepted$death_date),
  as.character(accepted$last_known_alive_date)
))

follow_up_days_from_consent <- as.numeric(
  endpoint_date - as.Date(accepted$enrolled_date)
)

has_eight_weeks <- !is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent) &
  follow_up_days_from_consent >= 56

summarise_mtb <- function(data, population) {
  denominator <- nrow(data)
  percent <- function(count) {
    if (denominator == 0L) NA_real_ else 100 * count / denominator
  }
  n_registered <- sum(data$mtb_reg == 1L, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_discussed <- sum(data$n_mtb >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_recommendation_reports <- sum(data$mtb_n_reports >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    population = population,
    patients = denominator,
    registered = n_registered,
    registered_percent = percent(n_registered),
    discussed = n_discussed,
    discussed_percent = percent(n_discussed),
    recommendation_report_sent = n_recommendation_reports,
    recommendation_report_sent_percent = percent(n_recommendation_reports),
    missing_registration = sum(is.na(data$mtb_reg)),
    missing_discussion = sum(is.na(data$n_mtb)),
    missing_recommendation_report = sum(is.na(data$mtb_n_reports)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

mtb_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  summarise_mtb(accepted, "All invitation accepters"),
  summarise_mtb(accepted[has_eight_weeks, ], "At least 8 weeks from consent")
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    died_before_eight_weeks = sum(
      !has_eight_weeks & !is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent) &
        follow_up_days_from_consent < 56 & accepted$status_death_unrestricted == 1L
    ),
    censored_before_eight_weeks = sum(
      !has_eight_weeks & !is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent) &
        follow_up_days_from_consent < 56 & accepted$status_death_unrestricted == 0L
    ),
    follow_up_date_missing = sum(is.na(follow_up_days_from_consent))
  )

distribution <- accepted |>
  dplyr::count(n_mtb, name = "patients", .drop = FALSE)

arrow::write_parquet(mtb_summary, summary_path, compression = "zstd")
arrow::write_parquet(distribution, distribution_path, compression = "zstd")
```

```{r}
#| label: mtb-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Molecular tumour board outcomes"
#| echo: false

mtb_summary |>
  dplyr::select(
    population, patients, registered, registered_percent, discussed,
    discussed_percent, recommendation_report_sent,
    recommendation_report_sent_percent, missing_registration,
    missing_discussion, missing_recommendation_report
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
